program.title: Interview ready: Clinical Informatics Nurse
program.goal: Be ready to apply and interview with confidence: a story for each competency, the job gaps closed or explained, and the planned learning done.

courses.title: Interview stories
courses.summary: A true example from your own work for each thing a panel scores. Write each one in Udyoga's story bank (situation, task, action, result) and say it aloud until it takes about two minutes.

topics.title: Prioritising a heavy workload
topics.details: Readiness 0%. To find one, ask yourself: What was the most urgent thing today, and how did you decide what came first? Answer in the first person with what you did and what changed.

topics.title: Accuracy and data quality
topics.details: Readiness 0%. To find one, ask yourself: Did you find or fix a mistake in any record or list today? What was it? Answer in the first person with what you did and what changed.

topics.title: Communication
topics.details: Readiness 0%. To find one, ask yourself: Who was the hardest person to talk to today, and how did you handle it? Answer in the first person with what you did and what changed.

topics.title: Working with others
topics.details: Readiness 25%. To find one, ask yourself: Who did you help today, or who helped you? Answer in the first person with what you did and what changed.

topics.title: Solving problems
topics.details: Readiness 0%. To find one, ask yourself: What problem did you solve today, and what did you try first? Answer in the first person with what you did and what changed.

topics.title: Initiative and improving things
topics.details: Readiness 0%. To find one, ask yourself: What would you change about how your team works, and why? Answer in the first person with what you did and what changed.

topics.title: Patients, customers and service users
topics.details: Readiness 0%. To find one, ask yourself: Tell me about one patient, customer or service user you helped today. Answer in the first person with what you did and what changed.

topics.title: Confidentiality and following policy
topics.details: Readiness 0%. To find one, ask yourself: Did anything today need care with confidential information? What did you do? Answer in the first person with what you did and what changed.

topics.title: Learning and using systems
topics.details: Readiness 0%. To find one, ask yourself: What did you do in a system today that a new starter would find hard? Answer in the first person with what you did and what changed.

topics.title: Training and supporting colleagues
topics.details: Readiness 0%. To find one, ask yourself: Did you show anyone how to do something today? Answer in the first person with what you did and what changed.

topics.title: Working under pressure
topics.details: Readiness 0%. To find one, ask yourself: When was today busiest, and what did you do to stay on top of it? Answer in the first person with what you did and what changed.

topics.title: Values and attitude
topics.details: Readiness 0%. To find one, ask yourself: What went well today that you are proud of? Answer in the first person with what you did and what changed.
